cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Pulled Away First
cards.instruction: Hide your role in creating the distance while working urgently to repair it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Here's your new key. Come in now; I've made your favourite lunch. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You changed the lock without telling me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. This key does both doors. Shall we try them before lunch gets cold?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I stood outside on my birthday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get candles. You can let yourself into the kitchen while I find them.

mechanism: A confidently directs a welcoming lunch and yields access testing and birthday ritual while urgently avoiding admission that A caused the exclusion.
confusable: Unlike an open apology, A responds to evidence with practical repair but never names A own choice; borrowed authority keeps B involved through accommodations.
comparison: Restored house access and belated birthday differ from unanswered correspondence and a waiting taxi.
seedUse: Use D85-b changed lock/key/favorite lunch/birthday/candles and S02-b making a workable plan around B willingness.
